theme: An open day — Toronto is the thing on the horizon.
greeting: Light on the calendar today, Dan — just the NACD program at one and an open evening. The real current is the ICGN panel you’re moderating in Toronto next week, and it’s asking for a decision from you now.

needsAttention.title: Reconcile the ICGN Toronto run of show
needsAttention.detail: Jen Sisson and Flo Clarke sent a reshaped set of session questions today and asked you to fold them into your plan; your panelists have already signed off on the version you circulated, so the two need reconciling before the Nov 5 panel.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged book-this-week back in September — a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out and prices climb, and a refundable hold costs nothing to place now.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by Sep 30 and book-by Oct 15 have both passed; six people over three weeks at the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, so each day narrows the choices.
